reader_summary.headline: Today, we debut a series called The Rewind.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we debut a series called The Rewind, in which Howard looks back on some of his memos over the years, discusses their origin. We begin with Howard's reflections on his very first memo, The Route to Performance, published on October 12, 1990. We just passed the 30th anniversary of the first memo on October the 12th.
